title: Tangy Apple Coleslaw with Cider and Honey
changes_from_base: Crisp apple matchsticks join the cabbage, and the dressing is sweetened with honey and sharpened with extra cider vinegar.
summary: A crunchy, tangy slaw of cabbage, carrot and green apple matchsticks in a light soured cream dressing sharpened with cider vinegar and honey.
equipment: salad spinner or clean tea towel

ingredients.item: tart green apples, cored and cut into matchsticks
fine sea salt or table salt, for wilting (most is rinsed off)

steps.title: Wilt
steps.text: Toss the cabbage and carrot with the wilting salt in the colander and leave 20 min. Rinse well under cold water and spin or pat very dry.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Whisk the soured cream, mayonnaise, vinegar, honey, mustard powder and pepper.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the cabbage, carrot and apple with the dressing. Taste and adjust with a little more vinegar or honey, then chill 30 min before serving.

tips: Cut the apple just before mixing so it stays white.
Rinse and dry the wilted cabbage well, or the dressing will be watery.
Lovely with grilled chicken or burgers.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; stir before serving. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
